column1: # Book conditions corrected from first principles (id<TAB>extra condition).
# Each is conjoined to the conditions G&R prints, by tools/gr/build_table.py and
# The automatic corrections (an integrand even in a parameter whose value is
# not: add p > 0) come from condaudit's .fix output; this file holds the ones
# ~ x^(-mu - 1/2) at Infinity, so it converges for mu > 1/2 only (the value's
# Gamma[mu - 1/2] has its pole there); G&R prints Re mu > 0.
# 3.165.2: the integrand 1/Sqrt[a^4 + 2 b^2 x^2 + x^4] is even in a, the value
# EllipticF[..]/(2 a) is odd: the formula holds for a > 0 (G&R prints
# a^2 > b^2, a^2 > 0, which admits a < 0, where it has the wrong sign).
